purpose: Clean-directory rebuild of the Lean sources for v1.4.0
procedure: Same procedure as logs/clean-replay-v1.2.0-receipt.json: fresh directory, sources and configuration copied from the release tree, shared Lake package cache for Mathlib at the pinned revision, fresh .lake/build.
Audit files run with `lake env lean` (logs: clean-replay-v1.4.0-audit-{general,bridge,carenini,equal-parity-b,equal-parity-b-certificates,hko-triameter,rm714}.log), all exit 0.

`lake env leanchecker <Module>` for the 14 modules new in v1.4.0 (ICGEqualParityB{Col,FD,Main,Graph,Cert1..6}, HKOTriameter, HKOTriameterDH, BrauerCMCore, RM714Weights), all exit 0 (log: clean-replay-v1.4.0-leanchecker-new-modules.log). Carenini was checked for v1.3.0 (clean-replay-v1.3.0-leanchecker-carenini.log); the other modules are unchanged since v1.2.0.
`shasum -a 256` of sources and configuration (logs/lean-sources-sha256.txt, 58 files), checked in the replay directory with `shasum -c` (58 of 58 OK).
